mobbin:06bcb061-a16d-4a6f-95bd-8c5e31c5f.summary: In an active huddle the user opens More, turns on push-to-talk, then gets a large hold-to-speak mic control with clear muted vs live affordances.
steps: PTT overlay — muted mic + Push-to-talk label
PTT tray — large green mic button
PTT tray — mic with active rings
steal: Push-to-talk as an explicit mode toggle under More (step 1) — default open mic vs hold-to-talk is a decision, not assumed.
Full-width muted PTT overlay with dismiss X (step 2) — glanceable 'you are not live' state before speaking.
Oversized bottom mic target (steps 3–4) — one-thumb hold for faculty who are gloved or holding gear.
Mute badge on the You tile plus the bottom control (steps 2–4) — dual indicators of live/muted state.
avoid: Burying PTT only under More (step 1) — for a dedicated room intercom, the mode should not require hunting in overflow.
mobbin:06bcb061-a16d-4a6f-95bd-8c5e31c5f.fit: Mobile wins for phone-as-intercom mic: hold-to-talk with huge target replaces open-mic risk into a live sim room; extends Baseline intercom, not SRV.
